recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, medium-close-up studio portrait of a woman with long, wind-swept rose-pink hair, wearing intricate gold and crystal mesh jewelry against a solid warm tan backdrop. The composition is balanced by minimalist, widely-spaced typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic harmony between skin tones, background, and hair highlights
Contrast between soft skin/hair textures and sharp, sparkling crystal mesh
Symmetry of the subject anchored by extreme horizontal tracking in the footer text
coreInvariants: Rose-pink hair with individual strands caught in motion
Crystal mesh choker and matching bikini top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the middle 70% of the vertical frame from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's direct gaze and the sparkling crystal mesh at the center of the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down to the jewelry, then out to the wide-tracked text at the bottom and the script in the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the head and shoulders to emphasize the minimalist aesthetic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-value highlights on the jewelry and hair sheen.

letterConstructionRules: Header text uses a fluid, slanted, brush-like script
Thin stroke weights for both styles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'A' has an elongated, sweeping crossbar
Sans-serif characters are reduced to minimal geometric forms
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, fast-moving script and rigid, static, widely-spaced geometric sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, geometric skeleton needed for the footer.
Matches the fluid, handwritten energy of the header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with long, flowing rose-pink hair, wearing a crystal mesh bikini and choker, centered against a solid warm tan background. Soft, even lighting with subtle highlights on the skin and hair.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a light-weight script title in the top-left corner. Add a geometric sans-serif name at the bottom, centered, with extreme horizontal tracking so it spans the width of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the footer text tracking wide enough to span the image width?
Does the hair color harmonize with the tan background?
Is the jewelry rendered with sharp, specular highlights?

adjustableVariables: Hair color (can shift within the warm/pink spectrum)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the hair against the background.
Ensure the crystal mesh looks like individual stones, not a solid texture.
Verify the text is perfectly horizontal and aligned.
Confirm the color palette remains within the tan/pink/gold range.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio portrait + centered subject + monochromatic warm palette + dual-font contrast (script vs. wide-tracked sans) = Minimalist Glamour Aesthetic.
